ResearchTabDef.label: jujutsu
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Research the secrets of jujutsu sorcery at a research bench: cursed materials, cursed tools, sorcerer training, and the path to Domain Expansion.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cursed materials refinement
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study the structure of cursed residue to refine it into stable, workable cursed materials. Unlocks the cursed materials bench.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cursed tool forging
ResearchProjectDef.description: Apply refined cursed materials to weapon-smithing, producing cursed blades that bite into spirits ordinary steel cannot harm.

ResearchProjectDef.label: jujutsu training methods
ResearchProjectDef.description: Codify the cursed energy training a jujutsu school imparts, accelerating how quickly your sorcerers refine their techniques and climb the grades.

ResearchProjectDef.label: reverse cursed technique training
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study the conversion of negative cursed energy into a positive healing output. Raises the chance of awakening RCT after surviving a qualifying combat downing from 5% to 10%. Only applies to downings that happen after this research is completed; it does not grant the RCT trait automatically.

ResearchProjectDef.label: simple domain
ResearchProjectDef.description: A defensive counter-domain that neutralizes incoming sure-hit techniques within a small radius. The first step toward true domain theory.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced cursed materials
ResearchProjectDef.description: Push cursed-material metallurgy to its limit, enabling the forging of high-grade cursed tools and reinforced sorcerer apparel.

ResearchProjectDef.label: domain expansion theory
ResearchProjectDef.description: The pinnacle of jujutsu research. By studying the innate domains of special-grade curses, your sorcerers learn to manifest an enclosed cursed-energy barrier of their own: a Domain Expansion.

ResearchProjectDef.label: jujutsu scroll transcription
ResearchProjectDef.description: Record learned jujutsu skills in training scrolls at the cursed materials bench. Unlocks New Shadow Style scroll writing. Simple Domain and Falling Blossom Emotion scrolls additionally require Simple Domain research; Domain Amplification scrolls additionally require Domain Expansion Theory. Finished scrolls must still be read by a sorcerer and cannot grant innate technique genes.
